entry.author: Whaikaha — Ministry of Disabled People
entry.summary:
We are inviting Pacific disabled people and their aiga to share their experience of disability via an online survey. The survey, with alternate formats available, complements a series of talanoa being held across the country. The information gathered during the talanoa and through the survey will help us develop the National Pacific Disability Action Plan.

The survey will be available online until 12 May: https://bit.ly/49Nz9hI
If you would prefer to respond to the survey by sending a video, audio message, or via email, you can send it to pacificpeoples@whaikaha.govt.nz
For alternate formats of the survey, visit our website: https://bit.ly/3Ut0AZs

Video description: Tofa, a Pacific woman is wearing a blue and black patterned dress with a red necklace and red flower in her hair. Slightly behind her on the right is an NZSL interpreter. They are standing in front of a grey background.
